# Python dependencies for Glide (Schrodinger) (tool/glide) — MANAGED BY Ramin & Elnaz (coordinators).
#
# Teams: do NOT edit this file. If your tool needs a package, ask a coordinator to add it here.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THIS TOOL NEEDS NO pip PACKAGES. The list below is intentionally empty.
#
# Why: the whole Glide workflow runs inside the Schrodinger suite, which ships its own
# Python. The only script in this workspace, docking/collect_results.py, imports nothing
# outside the standard library (csv, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, datetime), so
# `python docking/collect_results.py` works on any stock CPython 3.8+.
#
# What you actually need to reproduce this workspace:
#
#   1. Schrodinger Suite 2026-1 (Glide v11.0) with a valid licence.
#      Not installable via pip. Verify before starting:
#         $SCHRODINGER/licadmin debug-sources     # must list a local entitlement or a server
#         $SCHRODINGER/glide -docking-keywords    # prints the keyword set used here
#      Binaries used: utilities/prepwizard, ligprep, glide.
#      A local job server must be running:  $SCHRODINGER/jsc local-server-start
#
#   2. CPython 3.8+ on PATH, for docking/collect_results.py. Standard library only.
#
#   3. bash, to run preprocessing/preprocess.sh and docking/run_docking.sh.
#      On Windows, Git Bash works; the scripts detect the .exe launchers automatically.
#
#   4. To validate the result file, install the repo-root analysis toolchain instead:
#         pip install -r requirements.txt        # jsonschema, pyyaml, pandas, matplotlib, openpyxl
#      then: python scripts/compare_results/validate_results.py \
#                   tools/glide/results/DOCKING_RESULT.json
#
# Pinned versions actually used for the committed run are recorded in
# preprocessing/PREPROCESSING.yaml (software_versions) and in
# results/DOCKING_RESULT.json (software_version).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
